lessons: Rate-table completeness was the whole story here. The published fare table has six distance rings by three contract types by two mode groups; the skill carried five cells of it (yellow bus/train, green bus, light-blue bus, national monthly) and no daily-pass amount at all. Any future cycle must re-diff bus.gov.il/FaresDistance row by row, not spot-check the yellow ring.

The discount surface is 13 separate authority profile pages. Before this cycle the skill listed six. Re-enumerate the profile links on bus.gov.il/discounts each cycle; the authority adds profiles without changing the summary table.

scripts/check_transit.py had drifted to a fabricated '9 NIS raised from 8 NIS on Jan 1, 2026' single fare while SKILL.md said 8. Scripts are the surface nobody re-reads. Grep every hardcoded amount in scripts/ against the body on every cycle.

Deferred: Rav-Kav accrued-balance refunds after the reform (Dan's fares page mentions a refund of the remaining stored value). Needs an authority source before it goes in the body.

Deferred discretionary: the Jerusalem Red Line central section closure and operator-performance disputes reported in mid-2026 could justify a service-reliability gotcha, but no authoritative source was read this cycle.

Reference Links carried https://pti.org.il/derekh-shava/eng/, which returns HTTP 200 while redirecting to the Hebrew authority home page. Link checks that assert only on status will keep missing this class; assert on extracted text.
The fare table was right; the defects were in the conditions around it. Read every bus.gov.il profile page in full each cycle, not only the rate.

Check travel times, frequencies, line patterns and the Saturday restart against stop_times in the Ministry feed. This cycle the feed disproved a 30-minute Savidor to Jerusalem time, the Green Line end point and a 30-minutes-after-sunset restart that press and prose had carried.

Re-check the January 25, 2027 fare update. On November 17, 2026 the press reported a ministerial halt with funding unsettled, and no new table existed on November 23. Any new table changes every amount in the skill, the script and the FAQ.
Re-check whether the Green Line section to Gilo has opened, and the 2027 opening of the Eastern Railway southern section.
